title: Raw source record
description: A retrieved source record as returned by an evidence adapter. This is an input to evidence.normalize, not an evidence claim: it carries no claim text, confidence, or verification status.

record_id.description: Stable identifier of the record in its source system.

account_id.description: Resolved account this record belongs to. Must equal the requested account_id.

source_type.description: Uses the same taxonomy as evidence.schema.json so normalization is mechanical.

title.description: Record subject or record type label, for example 'Discovery call notes'.

content.description: Raw or extracted textual content. Never summarized by this skill.

source_uri.description: Address of the source when it is addressable.

published_at.description: Publication time when the source explicitly states one.

occurred_at.description: Event or activity occurrence time when the source explicitly states one; distinct from publication time.

question_ids.description: Question IDs the adapter considered this record relevant to. Relevance is the adapter's judgement, not a claim.

metadata.description: Controlled source-specific metadata: flat scalar values only. Standard keys include provider, record_type, author, channel, and object_name.
